title: Unsupervised machine learning guides discovery of a lithium solid electrolyte
summary: A variational autoencoder ranked unexplored element combinations for lithium solid electrolytes. Researchers combined those rankings with crystal-structure prediction and synthesis to discover Li₃.₃SnS₃.₃Cl₀.₇, then characterized its structure and lithium-ion transport. Impedance, NMR and lithium-cell measurements supported a new transport pathway and compatibility with lithium metal.
ai_technology: Unsupervised machine learning for element selection with crystal structure prediction

evidence.tested: Synthesis, diffraction, impedance and NMR characterization of the selected lithium solid electrolyte, with lithium plating/stripping measurements.
evidence.unknown: This is a laboratory material study; full-battery performance and independent replication were not assessed.
evidence.ai_role: An unsupervised variational autoencoder ranked chemical element combinations; human selection and crystal-structure calculations directed synthesis.
